release_notes: A return reduces profit in finance the same way the sales report does. A supplier payment, an approved expense, and an approved cash refund leave the cash account. Voiding a sale that already collected money asks for a second confirmation, and only a Super Admin confirmation is honored. The live dashboard can show and print the last sale on that screen. Reports count refunds in cash collected by method. A supplier delivery request shows its product lines and total. A stock count does not change stock until a Super Admin applies it. Extra user permissions are enforced on the till and the dashboard. A supplier payment larger than the open bills is kept as an advance, and a reversal cannot be reversed again. Audit history export includes every matching event. Licence details stay with the shop owner.
